A mystery anthology adapting crime and detective fiction for radio, with each broadcast presenting a separate case rather than a continuing detective storyline.

Mutual sustaining mystery anthology using a different established fictional detective each week. Frozen GRH set preserves four broadcasts, historical programs 4, 10, 11 and 12.

GRH documents the program through Mutual sustaining run (July 21, 1942 to September 5, 1943) on Mutual Broadcasting System.

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Frank Knight (announcer on 3 recordings), Alvin Flanagan (director on 2 recordings), John A. Bassett (radio adaptor on 2 recordings), Lee Wright (radio adaptor on 2 recordings), Ralph Barnhart (composer on 2 recordings), Robert Stanley (conductor on 2 recordings), and Agatha Christie (author on 1 recording).

The program is also connected in the archive to Mutual Broadcasting System (broadcast on network).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include classic detective fiction, literary detective-story radio adaptation, rotating famous detectives, female private detective and Rosika Storey, impossible crime and alibi mystery, and Hercule Poirot investigation.
